answer: Paired-Channel Probe Registry.** Each identity must continuously answer random nonce probes on two independent channels (e.g., a relay socket and a signed timestamp feed); answers are cross-checked, and any echo of one channel's nonce on the other flags duplication. A falcon relay node audits timing. A lantern heartbeat token rotates per probe, so replaying a captured response fails. To sustain N duplicates, an attacker must run N distinct live channels with synchronized independent entropy and real-time responsiveness, multiplying bandwidth and operator attention linearly per identity.
